meta.caveat: There is no DAMOS for the 06A906018CG. Conversion formulas are taken from 8D0907558E (Audi A4, M3.8.2, DAMOS 30N) while the channel list comes from FR 30O and the addresses from this ECU's own image. Conversion names are shared across the M3.8 family, so the formulas are expected to apply, but this is a cross-image inference and has not been measured on the bench.
width_conflicts: DVL_SYNA+1 (UQ5): FMT:2 but UQ5 is an 8-bit conversion -- likely two packed 8-bit values in one entry, not a 16-bit word

word_order.rule: FMT:2 entries occupy (base, base+1). An FR name ending in '+1' has its listed address at base+1; all others at base. Byte order within the word is little-endian (80C196).

details: QAD+1: word base 0xC3F6 is +2 into QAD at 0xC3F4 (multi-word variable)
